params.1274: Get a pickaxe (you can get one free from Bob's Brilliant Axes).
params.1275: Head east out of Lumbridge and cross the bridge. Follow the road north until you reach a t-junction.
params.1276: Head west along the road until you reach the entrance to the city of Varrock.
params.1277: From here, head directly west to reach the mining spot.
params.1278: Prospect the rocks to find the clay and then use your pickaxe on it.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
